parts: Female, white and gold, born on April 24, 2004. Shoulder height: 24.70 cm. Weight: 6.700 kg.

From the cross of Blinky Ghost de la Kassyna and Candela La Brillante de la Kassyna (litter sister of Baxter El Pionero), linebred to the great Ch. Ultra's Who's The Boss, this beautiful female was born, and we have high hopes for her as the foundation of our line. She is a litter sister of All That Magic.
On her only appearance in the ring in junior class, she won Best Junior and Best Female of the breed, BOS under Judge Mrs. Litz Cartledge.

She has a lovely outline and a beautiful, large head with a deep, well-defined stop, large, full eyes and perfectly aligned teeth, with barely any undershot jaw, almost a reverse scissor bite, and a very short muzzle. Excellent angulation and a very straight back give her great movement. Her coat has incredible length and quality, and is very dense with good texture.
We are very lucky to share our lives with this little girl.
Mother of our litters A, B and F.
